answer: A farm faking 277 aliases needs 277 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ferrous is the wall and the prism is the gate: The seat is earned with airport firefighter watch record: watches served at one airport across years of stands. A farm of 277 aliases must climb the wall 277 times, the ripple ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
